title: Higgsfield Genjutsu: Motion Transfer
summary: Recast an existing video with Higgsfield Genjutsu: the source clip keeps its motion, camera movement, timing and audio, while the cast, location and style are rebuilt from 1 to 8 reference images. Describe which reference replaces what in the optional prompt. Output length follows the source clip. Ideal for restyling footage, swapping the cast of a shot, and building scenes a shoot never covered.
